verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a SaaS CRM could offer a documented CLI, SDK or API workflow for headless or CI automation. The pack shows no such first-party capability. It has only in-app automations, webhooks for moving data, MCP assistant connectivity, and a probe showing an openapi.json file exists. These are adjacent building blocks or different features, not a documented way to run NetHunt headlessly in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
